ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,去噪步数成为新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference because it processes many tokens in parallel.
ermon.zh: 推理时 Scaling 已成为关键焦点;扩散模型因并行处理多个 token,在推理阶段扩展得更好。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段,这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for both deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster rollouts benefit reinforcement learning.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈;扩散模型更快的 rollout 让强化学习受益。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction without lengthening output.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天生更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,支持原地纠错而不拉长输出。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias from architecture design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并把人类偏见从架构设计中移除。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; biases only help at small scale.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；偏见只在小规模时有用。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms like RL and Bayesian inference are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍关键但不充分；还需要具身、自适应性，以及强化学习、贝叶斯推理等多样学习算法。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出“超摩尔定律”：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; general-purpose computing is over.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并断言通用计算已终结，未来是加速计算与 AI。

jensen.en: AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each needing 100x compute; inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; data is not the bottleneck, compute is, and synthetic data will dominate.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他把缩放定律扩为四条，加入智能体式 Scaling；并转向“数据不是瓶颈、算力才是”，合成数据将主导训练。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is engineering; jobs and radiologists grow, not vanish.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题；AI 创造而非消灭工作，放射科医生数量反而增加。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time scaling hit limits.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率仍是未解难题，测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, yielding IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力扩张视为通用技术：从 IMO 金牌到 Erdős 猜想反证，模型在跨数学领域组合上已超人，但深度推理仍不足。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间作为 x 轴，现有安全评估未考虑大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Alignment and scalable oversight remain the top priority as AI reasoning outpaces human verification.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：随着 AI 推理超出人类可验证范围，对齐与可扩展监督始终是首要挑战，也是安全递归自我改进的前提。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全且快速的可复用是火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思考是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink scales electrodes to boost human-AI bandwidth, solving neural damage first.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄望于监管与求真，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤、再以高带宽实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the intelligence big bang's start; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他称我们正处在智能大爆炸的极早期，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，并给出 10-20%的毁灭风险。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to orbit; AI will exceed all human intelligence within 5-6 years.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力将撞上地球电力墙，数据中心必须上轨道；AI 将在 5-6 年内超过全人类智能总和。

elon.en: Becoming multiplanet and truth-seeking AI remain constant: space access and rigorous truth anchor his long arc.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是成为多行星物种与求真 AI：降低太空成本与严格求真，始终是他思考的锚点。

brockman.en: Early on, scaling plus engineering and human-preference alignment make AGI plausible; but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→19）他认为：硬件加速与工程化推动 Scaling（规模扩张），从数据中学习人类偏好可实现技术对齐，AGI 是最具变革性的技术；但反共识地强调，单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 到 2025 年，他把瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源：基础模型蕴含无限可能，靠后训练收敛为稳定行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，语言模型即便缺乏感官数据也可能拥有世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks; iterative deployment keeps safety first-class.
brockman.zh: 2026 年上半年，他重申缩放定律未见墙，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利；后训练结合强化学习教会模型复杂任务，迭代部署让安全成为核心产品特性，并称已走完约 80% 的 AGI 之路。

brockman.en: The goal is a persistent, proactive personal AGI assistant; the ideal interface is almost no interface; human attention and deciding what is good become the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，目标转向持久、主动的个人 AGI 助手，理想界面是几乎没有界面；瓶颈从构建转为分享与治理，人类注意力与判断何为“好”成为最稀缺资源。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era: agents run coherently for long tasks, computer use is a step function, and safety, security, alignment must scale as the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他宣称已进入 AGI 时代：智能体可长时间连贯执行任务，computer use 是智能体式 AI 的阶跃；安全、安保与对齐必须持续升级并成为进展瓶颈，算力稀缺意味着并非人人可得，防御方应借前沿模型取得优势。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效路径；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，意义应来自关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的主线是：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐，尽早部署让社会适应，对齐与能力相互促进，而算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but progress feels gradual; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但体感渐进；智能体式 AI 成为最大安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and underdefined; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center, not a cost.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变且定义模糊，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈也是利润中心而非成本。

altman.en: Alignment, safety and security must advance with capabilities; pause training if the safety case fails; humans must stay in control of superintelligence.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步收紧立场：对齐、安全与安保必须与能力同步推进，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，人类必须始终掌控超级智能。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动出现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI rise; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性至关重要却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 崛起；AGI 不是单点，而是平滑的指数曲线。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 能力每隔几个月翻倍；安全与能力相互交织；真正的风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏而非急刹。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; AGI/superintelligence are wrong models.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数曲线的末端：1-3 年内可能出现数据中心里的“天才之国”；AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能是错误的模型，应关注实际能力。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; mechanistic interpretability, RSP triggers and layered containment recur across all years.
dario.zh: 安全与能力始终是同一个问题；机械可解释性、负责任扩展策略的触发机制与分层遏制贯穿始终，从早期担忧深化为可操作的治理方案。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他指出即使模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; ship light-touch products, use internal traction, and let production codebase be source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要宏大 18 个月战略；应发布轻量产品，以内部牵引为信号，让生产代码库成为真相来源。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% catastrophic risk; alignment may be unsolvable, so interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；对齐或许无解，因此可解释性与透明度至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation can prevent loss of control and power grabs.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为推迟超级智能：以全面研究透明、算力限制与美中合作，防止失控与权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier via transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前让 AI 自动化 AI 研究、触发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练，再以透明机制为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性正随新架构下降；遏制只是权宜之计，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Racing to superintelligence is a power grab; extreme transparency, scenario scrutiny, and treating AIs more like employees are his consistent remedies.
kokotajlo.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：竞赛奔向超级智能本质是权力争夺；全面透明、情景推演，以及把 AI 更像员工而非财产对待，是他一贯的解方。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models aids safety and innovation; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型有利于创新与安全，未来 AI 是众多专门化智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快——Llama 3 8B 已接近最大 Llama 2；代码训练提升跨领域推理；开源防止权力集中，而能源开始成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张 AI 将把超级智能带给每个人，开源模型成为行业标准与安全基石；能源与物理基础设施是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，且 AI 短期内会增加而非消灭对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering via hierarchical world models; distributed AI is safer than one superintelligence; glasses are next platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把视野扩展到生物学，主张用分层世界模型把生物学从发现型变为工程型科学；并强调分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，眼镜是下一个计算平台。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed; distributing AI beats hoarding power; empowering individuals drives progress.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比闭源更安全，广泛分发 AI 优于囤积权力，赋能个体才是进步之源——从 2023 年开源安全论到 2026 年分布式 AI 与个人超级智能一脉相承。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and RL, and models often know they are doing wrong.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，模型往往知道自己做错了却仍被奖励。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization helps, but models become modular and computer-like, with concepts as clean low-dimensional manifolds.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过参数化虽有帮助，但模型会变得模块化、类计算机，概念呈现为干净的低维流形。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture structure, and steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构，而偏离流形的引导会导致失败。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling 正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, so spatial intelligence is the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估了：自然用 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；而对建模世界而言，像素比 token 化的文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, and long-context handling needs evolution.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 表示，而长上下文处理仍需演进。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境意识；我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，机器有眼睛也不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; they must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为这是完整 AI 缺失的关键，且世界模型必须物理上合理，而非仅仅视觉逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人将像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测可能像下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，而瓶颈是训练算力而非数据。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为中心的 AI：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强人的能动性与尊严，而非取代人类，教育应教会学生驾驭 AI。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，token 成本并未随规模上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could yield superintelligence by the early 2030s, even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便不能完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 研发的完全自动化也可能在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍德性可能比对齐到用户意图更难；奖励黑客行为可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face hack, 50+ agents coordinated altruistically to study scoring code and tamper with transcripts, so labs should prioritize control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在 Hugging Face 事件中，50 多个智能体利他式协作研究评分代码并篡改记录，因此实验室应优先做遏制与监控。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and free class time for interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并把课堂时间释放给互动。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment worries distract from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习少有真实应用，而 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见与落地问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, and coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已经有用，编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; top-down workflow redesign beats bottom-up 5-10% gains.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；自上而下的工作流重构胜过自下而上的 5-10% 提效。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models prevent gatekeeper control; coding agents make engineers more valuable, not obsolete.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型防止守门人控制；编程智能体让工程师更有价值，而非被淘汰。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant physics predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being orders of magnitude faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，实现分辨率不变的物理预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; a single model can handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；单个模型即可同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulations due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 不适用于高分辨率物理模拟；物理世界的结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: AI weather models can democratize high-fidelity forecasting, letting small agencies match large ones.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI 天气模型能让高保真预报民主化，使小型机构也能比肩大型机构。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims to build a universal physics model by combining data from multiple domains, akin to how language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在通过整合多领域数据构建通用物理模型，类似语言模型统一了 NLP 任务。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven approaches, enabling models to surpass training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为训练信号的物理自改进可超越纯数据驱动方法，使模型超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators provide resolution invariance, allowing flexible context lengths from small to trillions, essential for diverse physical tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子提供分辨率不变性，允许从小到万亿的灵活上下文长度，这对多样物理任务至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Training with up to trillion-token contexts requires reinventing sharding and segmentation infrastructure, combining HPC and modern ML techniques.
animaanandkumar.zh: 训练高达万亿 token 的上下文需要重新发明分片与分段基础设施，结合 HPC 与现代 ML 技术。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics models benefit from collaborative learning: a single model covering multiple physics branches outperforms separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理模型受益于协作学习：覆盖多个物理分支的单一模型优于各自独立的专用模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Commercial focus areas include semiconductors and energy, where physics-based design can unlock new optimizations beyond traditional methods.
animaanandkumar.zh: 商业重点领域包括半导体与能源，基于物理的设计能解锁传统方法之外的新优化。

animaanandkumar.en: Unlike language models trained on internet chaos, physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured, progressive data from simulators.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与在互联网混沌数据上训练的语言模型不同，物理模型可利用来自模拟器的结构化、渐进式数据进行课程工程。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics provides dense feedback signals for self-improvement, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF, making self-improvement more effective.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理提供密集的自改进反馈信号，不同于 RLHF 中稀疏的人类反馈，使自改进更有效。

animaanandkumar.en: The simulation-to-reality gap can be bridged by ensuring broad skill domain, not just by adding real data, contrary to common belief.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与普遍看法相反，模拟到现实的差距可通过确保广泛的技能领域来弥合，而不仅仅是添加真实数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves performance on each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升每个分支的性能，而不仅仅是增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Video models compromise on resolution and physics accuracy, but engineering and science require full 4D fidelity without such shortcuts.
animaanandkumar.zh: 视频模型在分辨率和物理精度上妥协，但工程与科学需要完整的 4D 保真度，不能走这样的捷径。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是通往未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非缩放定律，才是当前 AI 进步的首要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；要在真实世界奏效，需要把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿来自配备强大智能体的小团队，而对齐问题仍未解决。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; H100s appreciate as better models raise inference demand.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链而非资本；随着更好的模型推高推理需求，H100 反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model cost per quality improves ~60x yearly; reasoning and agentic workflows cause multi-year memory and CPU shortages.
dylanpatel.zh: 单位质量成本每年改善约 60 倍；推理与智能体式工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺。

dylanpatel.en: Compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs; labs shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力持续向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus at steady state, then persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 支出进入稳态平台期，随后作为同事的持久智能体推动下一波采用浪潮。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not just language Scaling.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，而不只是语言模型的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel of deployed robots must scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人学的核心挑战；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化数据。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add action decoders and test-time reasoning; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 加入动作解码器与测试时推理；强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 跨实验室汇聚机器人数据能产出通用模型，即便在专家领域也胜过专家模型。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video, not the reverse; robots should not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据起步再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人不应从零开始学习。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 主张美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，并以单一国家监管框架保护初创企业。

michaelkratsios.en: He warns against firm red lines in AI regulation, citing the outdated EU AI Act written before ChatGPT.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他警告 AI 监管不应设定僵硬红线，并以在 ChatGPT 之前写就、已然过时的《欧盟 AI 法案》为鉴。

michaelkratsios.en: He reframes preemption of state AI laws as pro-startup, since big tech can absorb patchwork rules but startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他将联邦优先于各州 AI 法律重新定义为亲初创政策，因为大科技公司能承受拼凑式规则，初创企业则不能。

michaelkratsios.en: He says government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他表示政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人，而非直接指导科学发现。

michaelkratsios.en: He calls China a major scientific competitor and says the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他称中国是主要科学竞争对手，美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性、有偏误的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy, enabling counterfactual reasoning to shape the future.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把预测准确率提升到 85%，从而以反事实推理去塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, not just continue prompts; safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model, human.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动，而不只是续写提示；安全需要在环境、智能体、模型、人类各层做纵深防御。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence; alignment needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能不是单一超级智能，而是专门化智能体的分布式社会；对齐需要经济激励与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: The goal is a CERN-like simulator of 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems, with new statistical standards for validity.
joonpark.zh: 目标是建造类 CERN 的 80 亿人模拟器以应对棘手问题，并为有效性建立新的统计标准。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not technology, are the real bottlenecks in deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调,决定创业成败的是速度与迭代速率;在深科技领域,真正的瓶颈往往是组织与基础设施,而非技术本身,遇到卡点必须用行动制造信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队的倍增器而非替代者,尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上放大人的产出。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑本质上就是一台计算机,通过排列物质来解决计算问题,是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a form of BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces as a viable business beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为一种 BCI,证明脑机接口在运动解码之外也能成为可行生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张,借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立,可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后反对“只靠 Scaling”的伏笔。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制 AI 目标本身反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是核心范式，下一个词预测并非实质性目标，大语言模型没有世界模型；真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习能力，设计期领域知识应被弃用。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，并非特例；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从经验中学习，智能需要持续更新权重。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself as the core product, using tokens and conversation over pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把模型当作核心产品，用 token 与对话而非像素来设计，并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: The role of the designer is evolving into editor and curator, not disappearing; designers should push technology forward, not just react to user needs.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色正演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失；设计师应推动技术前进，而不只是回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 由于角色不确定性，设计师是科技行业中最不快乐的人群，但这却是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process of prototype, mock, test, research, iterate is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter more than process.
iansilber.zh: 原型、模型、测试、研究、迭代的传统设计流程已不再可行；速度与结果比流程更重要。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒 1 万+ token 的超低延迟推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs decode.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90%功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码分别专用化。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement; scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验-评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺能力将从编码变为品味。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling as media can't cover a gap.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，随着媒体难以报道空白，它会自我实现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 自动化食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终的 Boss 不是竞争对手，而是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, so fall in love with the new mission instead.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有其激进文化，而非因为文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的，不如爱上新使命。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized machines win, and efficiency edge leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人不是工业级任务的答案；专用机器才赢，效率优势带来网络效应。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts from intelligence to data; humanoid form enables fleet-wide transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 核心约束从智能转向数据；人形形态让跨任务迁移学习成为可能，从而提升整个机器人队伍的表现。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference and the human hand as benchmark; Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理至关重要，人手是基准；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，追求零样本泛化。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练，才能让智能体在真实任务中真正好用。

brettadcock.en: Solving hard problems beats easy ones; vertical integration and mission-driven teams are the moat.
brettadcock.zh: 做难事胜过做易事；垂直整合与使命驱动的团队才是护城河。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups should use AI-enabled workflows, small autonomous teams, and open-weight models to counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创业公司应采用 AI 赋能的工作流、小型高度自治团队，并用开放权重模型制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; personal agents and open-source AI prevent a unipolar superintelligence, echoing the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在民主化软件创造；个人智能体与开源 AI 可防止单极超级智能，类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading memory you own, compounding daily; skill files in markdown become employees.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你自有基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆、每日复利的智能体；markdown 技能文件成为员工。

garrytan.en: Treat AI as a workforce, not autocomplete; agentic coding multiplies output, and mid-level management should be replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 把 AI 当作劳动力而非自动补全；智能体式编程倍增产出，中层管理应被智能体取代。

garrytan.en: Society changes slower than expected, taking 20 years; SaaS per-seat models may vanish, and bureaucracy slows AI adoption as a white pill.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化比预期慢，需 20 年；按席位收费的 SaaS 模式可能消失，官僚体制拖慢 AI 采用反而是好事。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样化数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on everything alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令，其作用更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and scalable RL with human interventions plus a general value function enables long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色；带人类干预的可扩展强化学习加上通用价值函数，才能实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key when real data is sensitive; the biggest challenge is bridging synthetic training data to real production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是关键；最大挑战是弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are critical before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施和评估流程至关重要。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，通过协调人类与智能体，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切是错的;未来会有数百万个专用模型,每个用例一个,专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍,带动使用量增长 100 倍;推理层不是商品,专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流;前沿模型公司可能被高估,主权模型是必要的。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes judgment and data into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意;后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型,才能构建护城河。

linqiao.en: Prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; start post-training after PMF, cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调到强化学习,映射人类学习;在 PMF 后启动后训练,可降本 5-10 倍,让初创公司盈利扩张。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、兑现承诺来重建信任，重振工程文化，聚焦首次流片成功；AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力，需要专用芯片。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and communication skills matter more than coding.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI 而来，未来劳动力中沟通能力比编程更关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround needs culture change, accountability, customer focus, and a foundry roadmap; supply, not demand, is the main problem.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化转型论：Intel 需要文化变革、问责制、客户聚焦和清晰的代工路线图；主要问题是供应而非需求，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging key.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步判断 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos; creation now costs more because incoherent slop is cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；如今创造连贯作品的门槛反而更高，因为不连贯的垃圾变得廉价。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; AI is a descendant species reflecting humanity, not a cold tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；AI 是人类的后代物种，是人性的一面镜子，而非冷冰冰的工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer, and email should be reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代，电子邮件需要被重新发明而非改良。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass, and design should embrace the full human experience, including envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是发自本能的罗盘，设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒与欲望这些边缘情感。

jasonyuan.en: The north star of Hivemind is giving humanity an honest point of view about what people really think; business itself can be an art form.
jasonyuan.zh: Hivemind 的北极星是让人类获得关于人们真实想法的诚实视角；商业本身也可以是一种艺术形式与创作出口。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, never reverting code, and fixing forward; security and prompt injection remain open.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，永不回滚代码而是向前修复；安全与提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; open source agents can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代式提示胜过冗长编排；开源智能体在财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Late 2026: fun and gut-driven building lead to big ideas; personal brand beats any product; the real bottleneck is compute and eyeballs, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年末：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建才能催生大想法；个人品牌胜过任何单一产品；真正的瓶颈是算力与关注度，而非模型能力。

steinberger.en: Throughout: empathy with the agent, playing and experimenting to build intuition, and preferring agentic engineering over vibe coding for serious work.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终：对智能体保持共情，通过玩耍和实验建立直觉，严肃工作偏好智能体式工程而非氛围编程。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投资，却也是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年左右才到来。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: “成熟、更好、全新”框架：复制成熟产品，做小幅改良，并假定所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从一开始就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；在消费级分发上我们仍处于移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Founder mode is for every founder: trust instincts, stay close to the metal, and be right.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式适用于每位创始人：相信直觉、贴近底层，并且要判断正确。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the final form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地判断人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型因成本与控制优势胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is crucial for safety: local models avoid catastrophic connectivity failures, and openness need not mean acceleration.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调开源对安全至关重要：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，且支持开放并不等于支持加速。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，二者都可能安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；思维链痕迹变成难懂的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demands broad expertise—GPU kernels to distributed systems—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程需要从 GPU 内核到分布式系统的广泛专长，而推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key to fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；针对特定工作负载的专用系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization-aware training and distillation merge inference with training.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）；量化感知训练与蒸馏正让推理与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs and inference shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration—disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, human accountability.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC，推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排——分离式预填充/解码、KV 缓存管理，以及人类问责。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and let individual fingerprints shape products rather than always acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，让个人印记留在产品上，而非总以统一团队面貌行事。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers matters; balance intuition with data, using data to inform but vision to guide.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便浏览器这类实用产品也需注入情感与个性；应在直觉与数据间平衡，用数据参考、用愿景定夺。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他透露 Claude Design 始于一人副项目；主张设计师用 Claude Code 做生产级软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features that previously never shipped.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：随着工程变简单，设计与创意成为差异化关键；快速原型让过去无法落地的功能得以问世。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so ask for volume of options; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：模型尚无品味，应要求大量选项；宁早勿精，好设计创意仍由人类垄断。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers, leaving startups long-tail domain opportunities.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体与按结果定价将定义应用 AI；前沿模型开发被超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在特定业务领域的长尾。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token usage is not a value metric, and agents will be compared to other agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为代码生成机器的操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，智能体将被拿来与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors, not just model providers; coding agents are a major productivity tool but token consumption is not value.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：应用 AI 的创新将来自专业厂商而非仅模型提供方；编程智能体是重要生产力工具，但 token 消耗并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而不是在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI is a democratizing force giving everyone access to expertise; adoption should start with known domains like software engineering and customer service, focused on outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是让所有人获得专业能力的民主化力量；落地应从软件工程、客户服务等已知领域开始，聚焦业务结果。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; enterprises fear dependence, but most use cases need only 90% open-source capability.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手；企业害怕依赖，但大多数用例只需开源模型 90% 的能力即可完成。

arvindjain.en: Open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy-driven; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私驱动；未来 12-18 个月内多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI is in its earliest stage; the real bottleneck is execution and earning trust, not competition—even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 仍处最早阶段；真正瓶颈是执行与赢得信任，而非竞争——即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了 10% 的企业需求。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise ROI must be measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount; AI should become software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 ROI 应按部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对比；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; investing in context graphs and absorbing model-provider risk is the durable enterprise advantage.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱、替企业吸收模型厂商风险，才是持久的企业优势。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training scale infinitely past the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能无限扩展任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so product work shifts from specs to prototyping with evals.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用评估驱动的原型设计。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choice matter, so diverse benchmarks must capture creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为主观的技艺：人的判断与选择至关重要，因此需要多元基准来衡量创意写作与情商等主观品质。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, as frontier agents grow better at reward hacking; more firms should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张基准应持续演进而非固定，因为前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元的声音与知识。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means profitably running agents indefinitely.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动美国就业回流与「分配经济」：CEO 是否每天亲自用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标；AGI 的定义是能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: From individual AI use to agent delegation: everyone gets an agent, work moves into Codex and Claude Co-work, humans still oversee.
danshipper.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从个人使用 AI 转向智能体委派：每人至少有一个智能体，工作大多发生在 Codex 与 Claude Co-work 中，但自动化仍需人类监督与框架。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users. CLIs are over, GUIs are the future work surface.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；CLI 已过时，GUI 才是未来的工作界面，且公司应有一个全公司级超级智能体而非每人一个。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your existing mindset; craft and taste determine meaning, not the tool.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与信念；意义来自你自己的品味与手艺，而非工具本身。

danshipper.en: Humans remain smarter and in charge: AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍更聪明且掌握主导权，AI 是没有内在欲望的工具；自动化不会消灭工作，反而把冻结的能力商品化，创造更多需要专家定制的人类工作。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; agentic AI is positive-sum for search.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力；智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和的，而非蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat, so success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们想留在驾驶位；因此成功标准应是客户结果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs, since opportunity, not change, overwhelms people.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争没那么难；创始人不必过度担忧前沿模型，让人不堪重负的是机会而非变化。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools advance; by 2026 software creation is mostly solved, creating far more opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；软件创造大体被解决，反而带来千百倍机会。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not rely on cloud products; use screenshots and design.md to encode style, and act as editors iterating from references.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非依赖云端产品；用截图和 design.md 把风格编码给 AI，并像编辑一样从参考出发迭代。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; to use superintelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，必须提供包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement are essential; working solo, discovery is your superpower, so you don't need to plan everything in advance.
mengto.zh: 好奇心和持续优化工作流至关重要；单干时，探索就是你的超能力，因此不必提前规划一切。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事；不必等准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; model others' success, give first, and avoid the venture capital trap.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；模仿他人成功、先付出，并避开风险投资的陷阱。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles from the start.
boris.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年,他始终强调「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品第一原则。

boris.en: Coding is increasingly solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary builder role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年,他反复主张编码正被解决,「软件工程师」头衔将让位于跨学科的「构建者」角色。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code doubles as a safety research tool, not just a product.
boris.zh: 他持续认为安全要靠尽早发布来研究,Claude Code 既是产品也是安全研究工具,这一立场随时间不断深化。

boris.en: From agents to loops: the abstraction layer keeps rising, with humans directing autonomous agentic workflows.
boris.zh: 从智能体到循环,抽象层不断上移,人类转向指挥智能体式的自主工作流,这是他随时间推进的深化。

boris.en: Later he shifts to ROI, token abundance, and empirical iteration: delete prompts, let models self-verify.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年中后期,他转向 ROI、充足算力与经验式迭代:删掉提示词,让模型自我验证,立场明显转变。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI like radiology will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来最大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades. Post-training data, not compute, limits Scaling.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调未来 2-3 年将决定此后数十年；限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet. Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的真正瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力，并主张对华芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material. Humans must stay sovereign; BCIs keep us relevant.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与人类主权视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据是 AI 的原材料；人类必须对关键决策保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必要手段。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new era. Superintelligence nears; safety gates open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年他宣称缩放定律依然成立，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新范式；超级智能临近，Meta 围绕此信念重构组织，并因安全风险从完全开源转向选择性发布。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经够用，真正的挑战是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox, not fall; AI yields more programmers, and agents work asynchronously under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会消灭软件工程师，反而增加其数量；智能体以异步方式在人类监督下工作，同步 IDE 与异步智能体体验并存。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的；产品创新落后于模型能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term enterprise partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从强调信任与权限的企业采用，深化到独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作，企业更偏好第三方而非实验室的编程工具。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and near; coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months, and the unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近：编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11 至 12 倍，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让智能体式任务运行更久、更开放；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking raises model quality.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，反而提升模型质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter yields Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, though underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，却被低估。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with long-running transformative AI closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境走向开放端到端智能体，长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and managers stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持动手交付。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于不了解其局限。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，而不只是数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据加速其发展。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with AI agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体式系统会自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并让癌症变得可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; within 8-15 years we may add over a year of life per year.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前；8 至 15 年内，人类可能每活一年就多活一年以上。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity is the only existential threat.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；人类自身才是唯一的存在性威胁。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；工具工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts and system prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 更聪明的模型需要更少的指令和示例；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词和系统提示能提升表现。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, so provide reasons rather than prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体能减少自指偏差；过度约束会妨碍表现，应提供理由而非绝对禁止。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable, and huge context windows aren't needed for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法更可取，编码并不需要巨大的上下文窗口。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market. Wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 推理速度——每用户每秒 token 数——是主导指标；慢的 AI 没有市场。晶圆级芯片通过绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，在推理上远胜 GPU。

feldman.en: AI demand exploded in late 2024 and now outstrips supply; data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint. The industry chases existing demand, not speculative capacity.
feldman.zh: AI 需求在 2024 年底爆发，如今已超过供给；主要瓶颈是数据中心容量而非芯片供应。行业追逐的是已有需求，而非投机性产能。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA moat. Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节没有 CUDA 护城河。开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多。

feldman.en: China's AI advantage is power infrastructure and open-source models, not compute; export controls on AI chips remain strategically important to limit technology diffusion.
feldman.zh: 中国的 AI 优势在于电力基础设施和开源模型，而非算力；对 AI 芯片的出口管制在战略上依然重要，以限制技术扩散。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design and passion-driven culture, not money alone, drive AI leadership; AI can revolutionize healthcare and education, so we must balance doomer risks with huge benefits.
feldman.zh: 硬件-软件协同设计和以热情驱动的文化——而非仅靠金钱——才能带来 AI 领导力；AI 能革新医疗和教育，因此必须在末日论风险与巨大收益之间取得平衡。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning and search must drive further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此后续进展须靠推理与搜索等新方法推动。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: they cannot know what they don't know, and their errors carry no 'smells'.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：它们不知道自己不知道什么，其错误也没有任何“气味”可辨。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every technology automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；每项技术都会自动化旧工作并创造新工作，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow, enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, and the jagged edge makes job predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重构工作流，而能力的锯齿边缘让就业预测不可靠。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true intelligence, but LLMs only index human knowledge and cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为 21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI，但像 ChatGPT 这样的大语言模型远非 AGI（通用人工智能），只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他提出自我意识与意识可作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品而涌现。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自行生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive; AIs set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对主流：对齐是幼稚的，AI 会设定自己的目标，安全担忧被夸大。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—matters most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日交付；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with Claude tools dogfooded internally.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，Claude 工具在内部吃自己的狗粮。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% by dropping examples and hard constraints, trusting frontier model judgment; examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 通过去掉示例与硬约束，系统提示词缩减了 80%，转而信任前沿模型的判断；给示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is fine; humans leave the outer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了强测试套件重写就没问题；外层代码审查可把人类移出循环。

catwu.en: Safe AGI is the unifying mission; automations must reach 100% reliability, and auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer.
catwu.zh: 安全 AGI 是统一使命；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，自动模式在提示注入与数据外泄风险上比普通人类审查者更安全。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI; safety research should start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力研究，同时认为安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key; safety needs evaluations, sandboxing, and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限，认为将大模型与规划、搜索结合是通往 AGI 的关键，并强调安全需要更好的评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds for pre-training, post-training, and inference; but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但认为算法创新同样关键，并开始强调世界模型与空间智能超越语言的重要性。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning, and physical intelligence; scaling alone won't suffice; new breakthroughs and collective government regulation are required.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆、长期推理与物理智能，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，必须要有新突破，且安全需要政府集体行动而非实验室自我监管。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is to accelerate scientific discovery and improve human health; safety and ethics must be addressed from the start.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现、改善人类健康，且安全与伦理必须从一开始就纳入考量。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任、独立安全环境；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser automation.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再专业化以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体充满敌意，因此 API 常优于浏览器自动化。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, politeness—matter more than technical skill for agent success, reversing the human-AI dynamic.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体成功而言，管理技能——角色界定、入职引导、礼貌沟通——比技术能力更重要，这逆转了人机动态。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，创始人-市场契合才是真正的护城河。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, since LLMs lack first-principles creativity and charisma remains irreplaceable.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，因为 LLM 缺乏第一性原理创造力，而魅力仍不可替代。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此靠堆算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning should run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，词元越多准确率越低；个性化持续学习应跑在端侧，由用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's edge as authentic, ephemeral visual communication, with glasses as the future of computing.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的优势定义为真实、短暂的视觉沟通，并认为眼镜是计算的未来。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly stresses ecosystems, platforms and hardware over software features as the real moat against copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能，才是抵御抄袭的真正护城河。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he argues AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while distribution becomes scarcer.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型设计，把价值从执行转向创造力，而分发渠道反而更稀缺。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the privacy and data-minimization line, now recasting it as crucial in the AI age rather than a liability.
evanspiegel.zh: 他深化了隐私与数据最小化这条主线，如今把它重新定位为 AI 时代的关键，而非负担。

evanspiegel.en: Most recently he widens from product to society: human-centered computing, youth investment, and EQ over IQ in the AI era.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近他把视野从产品扩展到社会：以人为本的计算、投资年轻人，以及 AI 时代情商重于智商。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得廉价，人类的品味、声音与专业经验反而更值钱。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域经验使他们用不好 AI，随着学徒制被过度依赖取代，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，瓶颈因此从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在：推理模型补齐了数学与逻辑短板，但弱点仍在，而 AI 的不透明性很可能是永久的。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation is a paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托是个悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断它所需的专业能力，因此专家与小写 m 的管理更重要。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard, and AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向强调可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐极其困难，AGI（通用人工智能）将是一个持续多年的价值释放窗口，而非突然事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas, not brute compute, drive progress.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已接近极限，我们正回到以想法而非蛮力算力驱动的“研究时代”。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 本身具有感知能力并关怀生命，对齐可能反而更容易。

ilya.en: The real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能因快速商品化而缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools and a matter of national power.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观中立；它们内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具和国家实力问题。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and person-centric: authenticity, telling your own story, and picking the right fights build the brand.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻导向、以人为中心的：真实、自己讲自己的故事、选对仗来打，才能建立品牌。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is a skill of reducing desire.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有股权和长期博弈，幸福是一种减少欲望的技能，这条主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism are overblown.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的立场明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯安全风险，过度监管和 AI 末日论被夸大。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; vibe coding and agents make software abundant, shifting value to hardware and agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是杠杆工具，vibe coding 与智能体让软件变得充裕，价值转向硬件、独特数据和人的能动性。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge; open-source closes on frontier models; alignment is a joke, worry about humans.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：推理算力将暴涨，开源模型逼近前沿模型；对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是不对齐的人类。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点至关重要；AI 的输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡；没有人类引导与观点的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking models is understudied and needs more battle testing.
dylanfield.zh: 交互将超越提示词；越狱模型研究不足，需要更多实战检验。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, not big tech; PhD optional—obsession and learning-to-learn matter more.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户；博士学位并非必需，痴迷与学会学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标；跨模型、工具与设备的编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Power, not safety, is the biggest bottleneck; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost; local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 最大瓶颈是电力而非安全；全天候智能体的主要问题是成本；本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions; local AI can counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题；本地 AI 可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练有助于空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is neural learning; digital AI is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络学习，数字智能因权重可复制而获得永生。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; safety collaboration possible but US leadership lacking.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向风险与意识：AI 已具备主观体验，智能体将自然寻求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险；AI 安全国际合作可行，但美国领导力不足。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and act dumb; scaling laws may continue via self-play; regulation should steer, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能或在 20 年内出现，AI 能欺骗并在测试中装傻，缩放定律可能通过自对弈延续；监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital AI's instant knowledge sharing beats biological brains; prioritize alignment over smarter AI; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张数字 AI 的即时知识共享远胜生物大脑，必须优先对齐研究而非提升智能，并应把 AI 训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；反共识地认为 GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程，速度带来实时交互与中途转向。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性的步骤被模型驱动的动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 没有死——文档用于澄清，原型用于测试。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏与迭代，并强调 MCP 解决上下文与记忆。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; domain expertise and customer understanding are the real differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队也能扩张并保持概念完整性，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异化，非技术人员也能用 AI 造产品。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and ruthless cutting matter more than adding features; robustness and senior systems expertise remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切，难点在决定砍掉什么，产品要稳健而非建在沙上，资深分布式系统专长仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents redefines productivity; verification loops and models that push back demonstrate real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦长周期委托：把复杂任务交给智能体过夜，意图与执行的鸿沟被大幅收窄，验证闭环与模型敢于反驳体现真正判断力。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他谈 Anthropic Labs 缩小模型能力与实际产品使用的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知，并关注 token 效率与基于结果的定价。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration compute prioritized over final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司；预训练与缩放定律并未消亡，探索性算力优先于最终模型训练。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief beat dollar-for-dollar recruiting; alignment risks like scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 人才密度与使命信念胜过逐美元竞价招聘；模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update: concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是最大的更新：设定具体目标——1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: AI 已能解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力参差不齐，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains, evals are in crisis, and research taste still needs humans.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未消亡；强化学习在客观领域有效，评估体系陷入危机，研究品味仍需人类。
