bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征击败维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是通向真正理解的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models, not passive observation.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对单纯扩大深度或参数，认为 AI 需从被动观察转向主动智能体、因果推理与解耦世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的作用，并认为意识或只是注意力与世界模型的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he shifted to alarm: misalignment, self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向警报：对齐失败、自我保存、欺骗与谄媚已在实验中显现，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验的预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

kolter.en: ML framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，我们已进入后架构阶段，AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agents add prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体带来提示注入风险；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; interpretability may become real science via coding agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 红队已超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能借编码智能体成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling drive progress; safety requires explicit effort beyond Scaling.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构影响有限，数据与 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步；安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式努力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; it speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而不只是数据与算力；它让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI trust will grow like internet trust, and perfect interpretability is not required for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 信任会像互联网信任一样逐步形成，科学 AI 有用并不需要完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it narrows hypothesis space and enables resource-limited labs.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它缩小假设空间，让资源有限的实验室也能做复杂实验。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove it, via many mid-size wins.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是苦涩教训的反例：靠的是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling，成功来自许多中等规模的改进，而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: The model gives prediction and control, not understanding; understanding stays with humans, and grand challenges yield practical tools.
jumper.zh: 模型提供的是预测与控制，而非理解；理解仍属于人类，而攻克宏大挑战最终会带来实用工具。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is insufficient for human-centered design.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，仅靠数据不足以实现以人为本的设计。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think. Technology should amplify humanity, not replace sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物。技术应放大而非取代人类感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition draws on subconscious data. Play and diverse experiences are essential for design leadership.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；直觉基于潜意识数据。玩耍与多元经历对设计领导力至关重要。

ivyross.en: The future of work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; design leaders must speak business language.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更有价值；设计领导者必须懂商业语言。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and one-on-ones as live conversations, not status updates.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力的核心是信任、吃自己的狗粮，以及把一对一当作实时对话而非状态汇报。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是新瓶颈。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助的评审。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs stay in sync with code, often with AI help.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档与代码保持同步，往往借助 AI 完成。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; verification and quality frameworks matter more as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；随着速度提升，验证与质量框架更加重要。

fiona.en: High agency with high accountability, a growth mindset, and leaning into AI are essential for teams.
fiona.zh: 高自主性与高问责、成长型思维以及拥抱 AI，是团队在 AI 时代的关键。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow-state joy fades, satisfaction shifts to product impact.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；心流之乐消退，满足感转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code; next-gen engineers may need apprenticeship models.
fiona.zh: 产品经理也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；培养下一代工程师或需学徒制模式。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他提出自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一次 AI 突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; the future is objective-driven AI with world models, hierarchical planning, and open research.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是死胡同，未来属于目标驱动、具备世界模型与分层规划的 AI，并强调开放研究。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must arrive gradually so society adapts, as iPod and Nest show.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要渐进引入让社会适应，iPod 与 Nest 皆如此。

fadell.en: Between chapters, get bored for clarity; storytelling and press-release-first define the product, not just sell it.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他主张职业章节之间要留白、允许无聊以获清晰，并用讲故事与先写新闻稿来定义产品，而非事后推销。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 is opinion-based, and beginners' mindset beats experts for novel problems.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他提出：从止痛药而非维生素出发，1.0 版本靠观点而非数据决策，面对新问题初学者心态胜过专家。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop are required.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文，LLM 存在幻觉，因此需要特定上下文模型并保持人类在环。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone stays best form, displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合；智能手机仍是最佳形态，显示屏依然必要。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability matters.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：模型越来越小、越来越便宜，遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦 3-5 年内的近端能力与激进丰裕。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; the real danger is anthropomorphism, not AI welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：必须先遏制、再对齐，人类主义超级智能要始终站在人类一边；最大近端危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 福利。

suleyman.en: From OS and apps to agents and companions; the modern Turing test measures economic value.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年底到 2026 年，他把范式定义为从操作系统、应用转向智能体与伴侣，并提出以经济价值衡量的现代图灵测试。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models; superintelligence stays subordinate to humans, automating tasks not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：微软必须自建前沿模型实现自给，超级智能应服从人类，被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and uniqueness will get harder.
gustav.zh: 同年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非伪造，真正独特反而会变得更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure, expose data via APIs, and prototype with stack ranking.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，强调重建基础设施、通过 API 暴露公司数据，并用排序与原型来驱动创新。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost will force business model changes; podcast exclusivity was a bad bet, engagement and scale matter more.
gustav.zh: 他同时指出，推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变；播客独家是错误押注，参与度和规模比单次播放收入更重要。

gustav.en: No single org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer. AI should give users control, not make products more addictive.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之；AI 应让用户掌控算法，而不是让产品更上瘾。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是公司的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司用自己的智能在前沿运营，而不是建造防火墙。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 不可行；可靠证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and extends beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了 Scaling 卓越，而非仅仅消除错误，其市场远超安全关键等小众领域。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然有效，但结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up, not technical limits.
kaiser.zh: 经济压力推动部署更小、更便宜的模型，焦点从规模扩张转移，但这并非技术极限所致。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，这与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要仔细监督；编码智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress; they still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, lagging behind text.
kaiser.zh: 多模态模型尚未取得深度进展；它们仍像小补丁一样顺序处理输入，落后于文本。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并非显而易见，必须通过真实世界部署来推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每一方面，需要负责任地开发，安全研究必须在公开环境中进行。

murati.en: Focus requires saying no to good ideas; continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她持续主张聚焦需要拒绝好想法，并通过持续迭代部署与公众反馈来提升安全性。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration; AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她转向交互模型，主张实时高带宽人机协作，AI 应成为思考工具，而非回合制对话。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她深化立场：尽可能长时间保持人类在环，制度设计、透明与制衡比个人品格更重要。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as bigger models; open source aids safety via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正,强调数据质量与更多 token 和更大模型同等重要;开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场:算力扩张并非唯一路径,效率与数据质量同样关键,价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure and values; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, needing human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向主权与治理:主权 AI 要求掌控数据、基础设施与价值观;AI 是增强而非取代工作,需要人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization and agentic platforms with human validation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化,差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与带人类验证的智能体式平台。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; AGI is a direction, not a destination, and adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年最近他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施;AGI 是方向而非终点,企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; shared tools and platforms remain important for collaboration.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效能取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；共享工具和平台对协作仍然重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们是否理解几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills are easy to create as markdown files, enabling hyper-personalized automation; the VM sandbox provides safety and security, allowing Claude to install software without user approval.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能可以轻松创建为 markdown 文件，实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙箱提供安全保障，允许 Claude 在未经用户批准的情况下安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees, and society should discuss labor market changes; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工，社会应讨论劳动力市场变化；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，把数年的经验压缩到数周。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导 AI：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory cut overhead, and low precision pays off quadratically with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存降低开销，低精度收益随位宽呈二次方放大。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; API pricing leaks architecture details like KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼在一起，并无根本不同；API 定价会泄露 KV 头数等架构细节。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care to evolve.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护才能演化。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy is essential.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，简洁是表达本质，喜悦与幽默不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持创新应推动前进而非为破坏而破坏，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: mimicking combustion sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, with handling over straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张用户体验要真实，模拟燃油声是虚假的；性能是多维的，操控与横向动态比直线速度更重要。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用的可微分计算机；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张），会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; the cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小（不到 10 亿参数），可通过蒸馏实现。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像新的操作系统，并具有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能与顺行性遗忘。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; this is the decade of agents, and current reinforcement learning is terrible.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年，而当前用于 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕——像用吸管吸取监督信号，需要更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起我没敲过一行代码；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解——理解仍是人类的瓶颈。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are fragile: safety alignment can be undone with minimal compute; system-level safety and open development are essential.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最主流的微调技术，但微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training is where progress concentrates: data quality beats algorithms, with SFT, DPO, and RLVR each adding value.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量比算法选择更重要，监督微调（SFT）、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）各有用武之地，开源后训练能用小团队追上前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，能带来推理与工具使用能力；但模型会过度优化最易利用的信号，推理时扩展曲线是假象，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training, RL, and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但红利已尽；收益转向后训练、强化学习与推理扩展，Transformer 仍主导，创新在注意力机制与混合专家。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for the next decade, yet lag closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness through engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月；中国实验室靠工程执行而非范式发明主导开放生态，差距可能因算力约束而扩大。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出传统设计流程已经过时：伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: By 2026 he declares the research-diverge-converge process dead; AI shifts designers from mockups to helping engineers execute and shipping fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他宣告「研究—发散—收敛」流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向协助工程师落地并快速交付。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months, even at frontier companies, as speed and iteration replace long-term roadmaps.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年压缩到 3–6 个月，即便前沿公司也是如此，速度与迭代取代了长期路线图。

jennywen.en: He names three designer archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—favoring blank-slate hires over process-burdened seniors.
jennywen.zh: 他提出三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人，并倾向招聘无旧流程包袱的新人而非资深者。

jennywen.en: Across all talks, craft, taste, judgment and putting users at the center remain constant, while the process itself is what he abandons.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的是对工艺、品味、判断力与以用户为中心的坚持，而被他一贯抛弃的，是流程本身。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are needed.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他强调两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 到现代大语言模型不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新和推理时算力，而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具，能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they just require exponentially more compute for the same improvement, creating pressure for innovation. Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他反驳 Scaling（规模扩张）已死的说法：缩放定律并未失效，只是同样提升需要指数级更多算力，这倒逼创新；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

oriol.en: Superintelligence may first appear in narrow domains like science, not through general models alone; synthetic data helps but naive reuse creates harmful feedback loops; video without text holds world knowledge but models cannot extract it without language supervision.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为超级智能可能先出现在科学等狭窄领域，而非仅靠通用模型；合成数据有帮助，但简单复用模型输出会造成有害反馈循环；无文本的视频含丰富世界知识，但当前模型缺乏语言监督就提取不了。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练和强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非更新权重。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding; AGI may already be here by some definitions.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将超越专用脚手架；按某些定义，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain; the cost is low and it shapes future human-AI relations.
askell.zh: 即便不确定 AI 模型的道德地位,也应善待它们——代价很低,且会塑造未来的人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境,而非简单套用人类心理学类比;较老的模型有时反而比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Model welfare matters partly because it affects how future models perceive humanity, so treatment now sets precedent.
askell.zh: 模型福祉之所以重要,部分在于它影响未来模型如何看待人类,因此当下的对待方式会立下先例。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调,却缺乏真实世界经验,因而带有孩童般、独特的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution should guide less explicitly and leave more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强,宪法式引导应更少显式规定、留出更多判断空间;过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability; models' consciousness claims are weak evidence of real experience.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化对问责至关重要;模型自称有意识只是真实体验的弱证据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core of intelligence; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心，而当前机器学习系统缺失这一点；好奇心驱动、无目标探索，以及用模型分歧作为内在奖励，能提升样本效率。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robotics needs dynamic, modular policies and efficient sim-to-real transfer.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出，强化学习依赖密集奖励在现实中不切实际；真实机器人需要动态、模块化的策略，以及高效的模拟到现实迁移。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources—videos, simulation, real-world—via pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人学本质是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此必须利用视频、模拟和真实世界等所有数据源，通过预训练和后训练来学习。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors; a data flywheel enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：一个通用大脑，如同语言领域的 ChatGPT，可以驱动任何形态的机器人；数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调：部署是机器人学的主要技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题；它不能像软件那样快速 Scaling（规模扩张），需要严格测试。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估比基准更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like Elo steers models toward slop, not truth; labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 为参与度和 Elo 等排行榜优化会把模型引向垃圾内容而非真相；不同实验室因目标函数而分化。

edwinchen.en: Models can regress over 6-12 months if labs optimize on wrong data without proper measurement.
edwinchen.zh: 若实验室在缺乏正确衡量的情况下用错误数据优化，模型可能在 6-12 个月内退化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更关键；安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是主要风险。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and are interpretable with modern tools.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且借助现代工具已具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; data efficiency via curriculum and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；通过课程学习和合成数据提升数据效率至关重要。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, personalization, and human interaction in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复指出：语言集成能提升驾驶模型的表征、推理、个性化与人类交互能力。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs enables scalable deployment without retrofits.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他立场深化：搭载内置传感器的大众市场消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；与 OEM 合作可实现无需改装的规模化部署。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible, and safety always has a third option.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步反思：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；零样本泛化到 500 多个城市是可能的，且安全上总有第三种选择，而非电车难题。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and start simple to prove themselves before tackling complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观,创业公司要先做简单产品证明自己,再挑战复杂产品,并循序渐进地积累能力。

carlpei.en: The smartphone's future lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software, not major hardware changes; AI should be an ingredient, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年,他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件,而非硬件大改;AI 应作为体验的配料而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Hardware has the lowest margins; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, while large language models commoditize into a price war.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他提出硬件利润最低,公司必须超越硬件;同时大语言模型正商品化,陷入价格战,只有少数公司能胜出。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in a mature category; AI shifts interaction from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化为:在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段;AI 将交互从基于应用转向基于意图,智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Marketing is arbitrage and efficiency; content creation turns disadvantages into organic leverage, and the smartphone stays the best device for applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是:营销即套利与效率,内容创作把劣势变成自然流量的杠杆,而手机始终是应用 AI 的最佳设备。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日发布、持续迭代，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint—it's like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点——它像 MS-DOS；AI 应自行渲染界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严谨流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized super assistant that knows your goals, holds context, and takes actions to amplify humans.
turley.zh: 愿景是懂你目标、有上下文、能采取行动的个性化超级助手，用以放大人类能力。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth splits into friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自三分之一消除摩擦、三分之一核心产品投入、三分之一模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; pricing will evolve as tech changes.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富可供性产品；定价将随技术变化而演变。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward, and lab governance must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习和缓解风险；自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 努力实现的重要里程碑，实验室治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他提出反共识：AI 系统可以纯粹从数据中学习语义，而非依赖语法规则；神经网络常在有缺陷时仍能学习，使静默错误难以检测。

pachocki.en: Measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈，基准落后；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保障，而不仅是伦理；AGI 一词正变得无意义，这可能意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool providing interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是提供可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: RL alone is sufficient for continual learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided; hiding chain-of-thought in products is crucial to preserve its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：仅靠强化学习就足以实现持续学习，专门的持续学习实验室是误入歧途；在产品中隐藏思维链对保持其可解释性价值至关重要。

pachocki.en: AI for science is progressing, with models generating novel ideas in math and physics; long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI for science 正在进步，模型在数学和物理中产生新想法；长期对齐挑战的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; current models are already economically transformative, not just research curiosities.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；当前模型已具有经济变革性，而不仅是研究奇观。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines to capable AI; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：尽管通向强大 AI 的时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却增加了；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 解决 50 年蛋白质结构难题、GNOME 发现 220 万种新材料都是这一思路的体现。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而能用于创造性发现，FunSearch 用 LLM 发现新算法就是例证。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, through hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他坚持用高难度评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆，这是 DeepMind 科学 AI 的一贯方法论。

kohli.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他判断材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 在该领域的影响需要 5 到 10 年才能显现，与 AlphaFold 在生物学中的即时突破形成对比。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：后训练结合强化学习是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 的搜索技术已延伸到矩阵乘法等科学问题。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要，这是从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaTensor 一以贯之的主线。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他立场有所转变：可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需，AI 可以产出正确却难以理解的证明。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋，但并非全部。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy issues, and local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史包袱；本地语言模型可变革教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径：它为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网数据枯竭后提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems; language is the interface, tools are software, and vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; unsupervised learning should do most of the work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低级控制，LLM 负责高级规划；无监督学习应承担大部分工作。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics will come in about five years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and semantic design systems, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，并采用语义化设计系统而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions, empowered designers, ship fast and iterate over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张不惜一切代价追求速度：清晰决策、赋权设计师，快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须说清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool to attract top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是吸引顶尖人才的招聘工具。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“入职”问题并大幅提升模型智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为关键突破，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bar; success rate over time horizon measures progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力，用时间跨度上的成功率来衡量进展，并指出智能体式连贯性延长会极大扩展模型能做的事。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; it will accelerate AI research itself.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标与最可解的领域，并将加速 AI 研究本身，是通往 AGI 的直接路径。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; work becomes managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型存在巨大能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理成群的智能体，在更高抽象层级上运作。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better inference algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为借助更好的推理算法与数据，小模型也能在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她指出预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，而后训练阶段的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL needs careful engineering.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她深化为数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；强化学习需精细工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Open research and collaboration are crucial to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调开放研究与跨机构合作对抗衡封闭前沿模型实验室至关重要，并指出中国公司正引领开源贡献。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can be powerful; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张借助高质量合成数据与多元对齐，小语言模型也能强大；预训练中引入强化学习可提升推理能力。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈,引导工程师并对齐问题;把 AI 当作创作伙伴,开放地一起即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation and short cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需与技术债一起迭代偿还,靠快速、粗糙的实验和短周期推进。

nadchishtie.en: Design tools from the 90s (layers panel) are legacy; the future is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 90 年代的设计工具(图层面板) 已是遗留产物;未来是互操作的,代码即真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值;小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是标配;不采用它就像早期无视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost, and product quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他主张编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，自研模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本和产品质量都不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：编程从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will unfold over decades; benchmarks are poor proxies and local models won't win for coding.
truell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开；基准测试是糟糕的代理指标，本地模型在编程场景不会胜出。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on building skills, not worrying about capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议研究者专注技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，必须发展可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary; non-disparagement clauses are unethical.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他主张第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管措施必要，并谴责不贬低条款不道德。

leike.en: Empirical alignment research and measuring progress now are crucial; uncertainty about alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 始终强调实证对齐研究和当下衡量进展至关重要；对齐状态的不确定性才是最大风险。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题来训练，Scaling（规模扩张）加更多算力与数据会让 AI 更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; the best LLM applications are unforeseen, and big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，LLM 最佳用途常出乎创造者预料，而大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢产品发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期最大机会，模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口，并用混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities, RL reasoning, and coding matter, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI，智能体式能力、强化学习推理与编程才是关键，且 AGI 的经济影响被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment remains missing.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，但当前强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他主张先验知识应作用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, enabling image classification and protein binding prediction with minimal adaptation.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他强调预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，经最小适配即可完成图像分类与蛋白质结合预测。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, a concrete benchmark for embodied deployment.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出真实价值需要 99.9% 的可靠性；单个神经网络可跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化，这是具身落地的具体基准。

abbeel.en: Generality of the human brain inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失效。
